card: Updates documentation to record implemented standards BIP 389 (multipath descriptors) and BIP 394 (rawtr). It adds entries for both BIPs in doc/bips.md and references BIP 394 beside rawtr() in doc/descriptors.md. This resolves omitted references for features implemented in v24.0 and v29.0.
changed_since_previous: Diff provided matches the previous summary; no functional change.
evidence: PR description: 'BIP 394 (rawtr()) was merged in bitcoin/bips#2251. rawtr() has been implemented since v24.0 (#23480), and BIP 389 (multipath) since v29.0 (#22838).'
problem: Documentation listing implemented BIPs is out of date: doc/bips.md is missing entries for BIP 389 (multipath, implemented in v29.0) and BIP 394 (rawtr, implemented in v24.0), and doc/descriptors.md lacks a BIP specification link for rawtr().
summary: Updates documentation to include BIP 389 (multipath descriptors) and BIP 394 (rawtr() descriptors) in doc/bips.md, and adds a reference to BIP 394 in doc/descriptors.md. Both specifications document features that were implemented in previous releases.
